verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents built-in, per-realm SCIM endpoints for managing users and groups. Setup is covered: enabling SCIM for a realm, obtaining the SCIM API base URL, and creating a service account client. This lets a customer directory push provisioning and deprovisioning into Keycloak, with protected admin users excluded from SCIM management. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SCIM deactivation or deletion immediately ends active sessions and tokens in downstream apps, detail on group-sync semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that SCIM provisioning works in practice.
